content.short: UNCX Network is a multi-chain DeFi services provider.
content.description: UNCX Network, formerly UniCrypt, delivers DeFi infrastructure and services designed to simplify building and launching new projects. It provides token lockers, liquidity locking, minting, and crowdfunding tools, consolidating core liquidity and token-management capabilities into a single, integrated platform. Supporting Ethereum, Avalanche, BNB Chain, Arbitrum, Polygon, Bitcoin, Tron, Solana, Base, and Celo, UNCX Network enables teams to secure funds, lock liquidity, and deploy cross‑chain tokenomics with confidence.
content.meta: UNCX Network provides DeFi tools including token lockers, liquidity locking, and minting. Discover UNCX Network and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
